raw.description:
Marketing Lead

Department: Marketing

Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer

Work type: Full-time

Workplace: Fully remote (we hire globally, apply under the region closest to you)

Your Next Role Deserves Better.

Shape the future of AI from anywhere in the world. At AIVM, we're building the infrastructure that makes AI trusted at machine scale, and a team of people who are as driven by that mission as we are. Whether you're an engineer, designer, marketer, or operations professional, joining AIVM means becoming part of a global team that values your mind, supports your growth, and celebrates what makes you unique. .

Not Just Ideas: Our Actual Stack.

AIVM is building the infrastructure for the agentic economy — the frontier stack to deploy, verify, and govern AI agents with identity, accountability, and real-time settlement. On top of it, we're building a growing suite of consumer-facing AI products for both B2B and B2C, plus the tools, APIs, and SDKs behind them. Together, they give businesses and everyday users AI they can actually trust.

About AIVM

AIVM makes AI trusted at machine scale. We give AI agents identity, accountability, and real-time settlement — frontier infrastructure to deploy, verify, and govern them as they take on real work for real companies. Our first product, AIVM Brain, is already in market, bringing governed, verifiable AI to enterprise customers today, while the wider protocol is built in parallel.

You would be joining at the most exciting possible moment. The category is being defined right now, we have two fronts to scale in parallel (AIVM as the infrastructure company and Brain as the product already in customers' hands), and you'll be at the center of both.

About the Role

We're looking for a Marketing Lead to work directly alongside our CMO. This is a high-ownership role for someone who can think in strategy and execute in reality: one day you're building a go-to-market plan, the next you're shipping short-form content, spinning up a growth experiment, or setting up an AI automation to make the whole team faster.

You'll help drive marketing across two fronts at once: scaling AIVM, the infrastructure company, and running full-cycle growth for our consumer-facing AI products across B2B and B2C. That means you're equally comfortable with technical, developer-led infrastructure marketing and consumer-grade product growth.

You are deeply creative, deeply online, and deeply AI-native. You understand both Web3 and Web2 tech culture, you know what's trending across platforms before it peaks, and you instinctively reach for AI tools to move faster. If you're the type of marketer who's already automating half your own workflow and can't stop noticing what makes launch videos, UGC, and short-form content actually work, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

  • Work directly with the CMO, assisting day-to-day across the full spread of marketing activities and owning execution end-to-end.
  • Plan and ship social content across our channels, matching the pace and culture of each platform (Twitter/X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, and more).
  • Drive go-to-market execution for both AIVM and our consumer AI products: turn strategy into concrete, sequenced launch and growth plans and then make them happen.
  • Develop creative marketing strategies and campaign concepts that cut through a noisy AI and crypto landscape.
  • Design and run growth campaigns and growth plans, from experiment design through to measurement and iteration.
  • Track the market and emerging trends closely and surface the most relevant ones to the teamt, turning cultural moments into content and campaign opportunities.
  • Produce and direct short-form content: launch videos, UGC-style content, and platform-native video for TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and X.
  • Run full-cycle go-to-market and growth for our consumer AI products across B2B and B2C, from top-of-funnel awareness through activation, retention, and referral.
  • Set up AI automations and AI-native workflows that improve how the whole marketing team operates.
  • Support the broader marketing engine across SEO, PR, growth hacking, YouTube, and more.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • A strong, well-rounded marketer with real depth across multiple domains: go-to-market, growth, content, social, SEO, and PR. You don't need to be the world's best at all of them, but you should be genuinely capable across the board and sharp in several.
  • A creative mind who generates ideas, campaigns, and hooks, and who can also execute them without waiting to be told how.
  • Fluency in both Web3 and Web2 tech culture. You understand crypto-native audiences and you understand mainstream tech culture, and you can speak to each without missing a beat.
  • Deep platform knowledge across Twitter/X, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube (including Shorts), with a real feel for what performs on each.
  • A clear grasp of current content formats and trends: launch videos, UGC-style content, and short-form video, and why they work.
  • AI-native to the core. You use AI tools daily, you know how to set up AI automations to improve workflows, and you're always looking for the next tool that makes you faster.
  • A solid understanding of go-to-market motions, ideally including developer-led and self-serve funnels.
  • Experience with, or a strong appetite for, scaling consumer products, especially AI consumer products, across the full growth cycle for both B2B and B2C audiences.
  • A builder's bias toward action: you'd rather ship, learn, and iterate than wait for perfect.

Bonus Points

  • You've helped take a consumer AI product to market and grow it.
  • Worked in web3/ crypto industry.
  • You have hands-on experience with growth hacking tactics and can point to experiments you've run and scaled.
  • You've built AI agents or automations that replaced manual marketing work.
  • You have a track record in short-form video, either producing it yourself or directing creators.
  • You've worked in or around crypto / Web3 and understand the culture from the inside.
  • You have working knowledge of SEO and GEO / AI-search visibility (getting cited by LLMs and AI answer engines).
  • You've owned PR or earned-media motions.
  • You have a personal build-in-public presence or an audience of your own.

Benefits

Why Join Us

  • Two fronts, one seat. Help scale AIVM the infrastructure company and our consumer AI products across B2B and B2C at the same time. Few marketing roles give you this range.
  • Direct line to the CMO. You'll work as their right hand, learn fast, and have real influence over how we go to market.
  • Category-defining timing. The trust layer for the agentic economy is being built right now, and no one has won it yet.
  • Real ownership. We hire people to teach us things, not to be told what to do. You'll have the autonomy to run.
  • Global, sharp team. Collaborate with some of the best minds in AI and crypto, across 25+ countries.

Employees With Benefits.

Check out the following, we think you'll want to see what we bring to the table.

  • PTO: Flexible PTO system based on trust and tenure, including Holidays.
  • Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere. Results matter more than location.
  • A Schedule That Matches You: Work when you're most productive.
  • Multiple Ways to Earn: Multiple ways to earn more through IDO, whitelabel, and employee referrals.
  • All Access to Tools: We cover the software and services that help you succeed.
  • Climb That Ladder: We prioritize internal promotions and give you the resources to grow with us.
  • Open Door Policy: No silos, no egos, just a collaborative and supportive team.
  • Micromanagement, Who?: We hire people to teach us things, not to be told what to do.
  • Get Connected: Collaborate with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

More About AIVM

Global Team and Diversity. AIVM is a globally distributed team spread across 25+ countries, full of sharp thinkers, creative problem-solvers, and builders from all walks of life. This diverse mix of backgrounds and perspectives enables us to remain adaptable, innovative, and prepared to tackle challenges from every angle, regardless of the time zone.

Support for Learning and Experimentation. We champion a culture of continuous learning and experimentation. Team members are encouraged to explore new tools, attend industry conferences, enroll in courses, and initiate internal projects.

The Team Culture. We're a welcoming, global team that believes good people build great things. Everyone has a voice here. Everyone contributes. And everyone has the opportunity to make a real impact, not just within the company, but across the wider AI and crypto ecosystem.

Company Culture and Values

At ChainGPT, we value Trust, Effective Speed, Innovation, and Growth. As our Marketing Lead, you will embody these core values and have the opportunity to contribute to our culture and help drive our success. Join us on this exciting journey as we shape the future of blockchain and crypto technology.

Additional Information:

  1. Employment Compliance and Confidentiality:
    1. All employees will be onboarded through our official payroll and HR provider, which manages employment documentation, tax withholdings, and compliance with legal requirements based on the employee’s country of residence. As part of the onboarding process, each new hire is required to complete a Know Your Customer (KYC) verification, sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA), execute an employment contract, and fulfill any additional legal requirements specific to your jurisdiction. This process ensures compliance, protects company information, and establishes a secure and professional employment relationship.
  2. Employment Structure:
    1. The position is offered on either an employee or contractor basis, depending on the location and role. Individuals will receive payment via direct deposit on a monthly basis. Additional details regarding compensation, benefits, and company policies will be provided during onboarding and outlined in the official employment agreement.
  3. Compensation:
    1. Salaries are paid in fiat currency via direct deposit on a monthly schedule, with payments issued on the first business day of each month. This structure ensures timely and transparent compensation aligned with local financial systems.
  4. Probationary Period:
    1. All new employees will undergo a 90-day probationary period, which serves as a mutual evaluation phase. During this time, both the employee and ChainGPT can assess fit, performance, and long-term alignment with the role and company.

raw.description:
Career Category

Supply Chain

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Associate Director of Data Science – Global Supply Chain Digital

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. The Global Supply Chain Digital Team at Amgen is seeking an Associate Director of Data Science to join the cross-functional Global Supply Chain organization, based either at our Thousand Oaks headquarters or remotely.

In this vital role, you will lead the development and deployment of advanced analytics, AI/ML, GenAI, and digital solutions that transform Global Supply Chain operations and enable reliable delivery of critical medicines to patients worldwide. This role combines strategic leadership with deep technical expertise. In addition to leading advanced data science initiatives, the Associate Director will help establish and scale Amgen’s India-based digital capability team supporting Global Supply Chain. This includes helping define the organizational structure, operating model, governance, and delivery processes for a team of data scientists and digital developers, while providing ongoing leadership and oversight once the organization is established. We are seeking a Data Science leader with expertise in AI/ML, advanced analytics, digital product development, and modern data architecture, along with a strong understanding of supply chain and manufacturing operations. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, IT, and Digital Technology teams to develop scalable solutions that improve forecasting, planning, inventory optimization, productivity, and operational performance.

Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

  • Design and deploy AI, GenAI, Agentic, and advanced analytics solutions to transform end-to-end Supply Chain operations.

  • Lead the development of scalable digital products, analytical applications, and automation capabilities using large and complex datasets.

  • Help establish and scale a Global Supply Chain Digital capability team in India, including organizational design, operating model development, governance, and delivery processes.

  • Provide leadership and oversight for global teams of data scientists and digital developers across onshore and offshore locations.

  • Partner with business leaders, IT, and data engineering teams to deliver robust, scalable, and business-aligned analytics solutions.

  • Develop impactful visualizations and executive-level insights that support strategic decision-making and operational transformation.

  • Explore and implement emerging technologies and modern data science practices to enhance organizational capabilities.

  • Lead productivity analytics initiatives and develop KPIs and performance metrics that drive operational excellence across the global supply chain.

  • Mentor and develop Digital/Data Science staff while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Required Skills

  • People leadership and organizational management experience

  • Experience building and scaling global or offshore technical teams

  • Experience developing scalable data science applications for manufacturing or supply chain operations

  • Strong expertise in AI/ML, GenAI, advanced analytics, and digital product development

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL

  • Experience working with large, complex datasets and modern data architecture

  • Experience working in Agile teams to deliver digital products

  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Spotfire and Matplotlib

  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic leader we seek is an individual with these qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree and 3 years of Engineering, Computer Science, Operations, Analytics, Data Science, or related scientific experience OR

  • Master’s degree and 5 years of Engineering, Computer Science, Operations, Analytics, Data Science, or related scientific experience OR

  • Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of Engineering, Computer Science, Operations, Analytics, Data Science, or related scientific experience OR

  • Associate’s degree and 12 years of Engineering, Computer Science, Operations, Analytics, Data Science, or related scientific experience OR

  • High school diploma / GED and 14 years of Engineering, Computer Science, Operations, Analytics, Data Science, or related scientific experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Passion for data-driven business transformation and innovation

  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced global environment

  • Experience working in manufacturing, operations, or supply chain domains

  • Experience working within highly collaborative, matrixed, and global organizations

  • Demonstrated ability to influence and drive alignment across technical and business teams

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts

  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan

  • Stock-based long-term incentives

  • Award-winning time-off plans

  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

raw.description:
CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, and now we're expanding our platform to solve broader sales planning challenges. Recognized by industry analysts like Forrester and G2 and backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia, ICONIQ, Accel, and Sapphire Ventures, we empower high-growth companies like Netflix, Figma, and Stripe with the flexibility and insights needed to drive revenue performance.

About the Role

CaptivateIQ is building AI capabilities that will transform how enterprises manage sales performance. We're looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** to set the technical strategy for our Agentic SDK team, an internal developer platform that enables product teams across the company to build AI-powered features.

This is a strategic technical leadership role with multi-year, multi-team scope. You'll define the architecture and technical direction for AI at CaptivateIQ, making decisions that have no clear answer and partnering with senior Engineering, Product, and Design leadership to shape our long-term vision. You'll be responsible for technical choices that affect the entire organization, from platform design to engineering-wide quality standards.

As the technical anchor on a small, high-impact team, you'll lead by influence across organizational boundaries. You'll drive alignment between product teams consuming the Agentic SDK and the platform capabilities we build. You'll establish the bar for engineering excellence and invest deeply in coaching P4 engineers toward staff-level impact.

This is a rare greenfield opportunity to define how AI gets built at a growing enterprise software company. You'll shape not just the technology, but the culture and practices that scale with the organization.

Job Location

Remote - US

Responsibilities

  • Set the multi-year technical strategy for AI platform development, partnering with senior EPD leadership on long-term vision
  • Architect foundational AI systems that serve multiple product teams, including LLM orchestration frameworks, MCP infrastructure, and agent patterns
  • Own technical decisions with organization-wide impact where the right answer is ambiguous or contested
  • Define engineering-wide quality standards and best practices for AI development, establishing patterns that scale across teams
  • Drive technical alignment across the Agentic SDK team and product teams consuming AI capabilities
  • Invest deeply in coaching P4 engineers, helping them develop toward staff-level scope and strategic thinking
  • Represent CaptivateIQ's technical perspective in industry discussions, open-source contributions, or technical publications

Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience with demonstrated progression into staff-level technical leadership
  • Deep expertise in LLM orchestration: production experience building agent frameworks, including agent design patterns, tool integration, and workflow optimization
  • Significant experience designing MCP integrations and knowledge systems at scale, including tool server architecture, embedding pipelines, and context optimization
  • Track record of setting technical strategy that spans multiple teams and multi-year time horizons
  • Experience partnering with senior leadership (Directors, VPs) to align technical direction with business objectives
  • Demonstrated ability to make high-stakes technical decisions under extreme ambiguity
  • Strong mentorship track record, particularly in developing senior engineers toward staff-level impact
  • Demonstrated curiosity and continuous learning in the rapidly evolving AI/LLM space

Bonus

  • Strong proficiency in Python and experience with Django or similar backend frameworks
  • Full-stack capabilities with React and TypeScript
  • Experience building and scaling internal AI/ML platforms or developer experience infrastructure
  • Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent)
  • Deep expertise in advanced agent architectures: multi-agent coordination, autonomous planning, or complex tool ecosystems
  • Experience with AI evaluation, observability, and production monitoring at enterprise scale
  • Published technical writing, conference talks, or significant open-source contributions in AI/ML
  • Background building AI-powered products that shipped to enterprise customers with measurable business impact
  • Experience at a B2B SaaS company during periods of significant growth or platform expansion
  • Familiarity with sales performance management, incentive compensation, or adjacent enterprise domains

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Healthcare: 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for all FTEs, with roughly 75% coverage for dependents.
  • Flexible Time Off: Flexible vacation days plus quarterly mental health days to ensure you have the space to recharge.
  • Annual Stipends: Dedicated funds for your professional development and caretaking needs.
  • Work Anniversary Bonuses: Annual bonuses to celebrate your milestones and contributions to the CaptivateIQ team that grow as your tenure does.
  • Retirement Savings (US-Only): A 401(k) plan to help you invest in and secure your future.
  • Premium Tools: The latest Apple hardware to empower you to do your best work.
  • Inclusive Community: Active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that celebrate shared identities and support our DEI goals by fostering an environment where diverse talent thrives.

Notice to Prospective Candidates

  • Only emails from @captivateiq.com should be trusted.
  • We are aware of active recruitment scams using the CaptivateIQ name, in which individuals pose as our recruiters and post fake remote job openings and make fake job offers on the Internet. Please note, we will never do the following:Attempt to correspond with a candidate using a free web-based account, such as an email address that ends in @gmail.com, @yahoo.com, @hotmail.com, etc.
  • Make an offer of employment without conducting multiple rounds of interviews face-to-face using secure video-conferencing technology.
  • Ask candidates to cash checks to buy equipment on behalf of CaptivateIQ.
  • Ask candidates to make a payment in order to be considered for a position.
  • Make early requests for candidates' personal information such as date of birth, passport details, credit card numbers, bank details and social security number, etc.
  • Please note that we’ll only ask for more sensitive personal information in connection with background checks after an offer is made.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to provide after-hours support, ensuring timely resolution of critical issues and maintaining system uptime.
